data.value: Content engine size limit reached

data.name: coverage.engine_size_limit.next

data.name: coverage.archive_not_expanded.title

data.value: Encrypted content not decrypted

data.name: coverage.resource_limit.title
data.value: Inspection safety limit reached

data.name: coverage.resource_limit.next
data.value: A scan budget or component limit was reached; this does not establish low system memory. Review the limit, adjust the relevant budget, or scan smaller directories. Available results are retained; keep protection enabled.

data.name: execution.allocation_failed.title
data.value: Scan component memory allocation failed

data.name: execution.allocation_failed.next
data.value: Export the diagnostic records and scan the remaining content in smaller batches. Available results are retained; keep protection enabled.

data.name: coverage.content_not_started.title
data.value: Some checks were not performed

data.name: coverage.content_not_started.next
data.value: Confirm that the scan component is available, then rescan. Available results are retained.

data.name: coverage.amsi_unavailable.next
data.value: Check that local security software is enabled and functioning, then retry. A full content scan cannot replace an unavailable security software interface.

data.name: coverage.unsafe_path.title
data.value: Path could not be safely inspected

data.value: Verify read permissions and rescan. Access failure does not establish that a target is safe or malicious.
